objective: Remove redundant work while preserving the narrow draw-fixed search at fixed depth
features: Quiescence skips an unused repetition-context hash loop
Try the existing history-safe transposition return before legal move generation, retaining draw/mate exceptions
unchanged: Narrow draw protection, search decisions, mate-distance bounds, TT storage/reuse conditions, evaluation, clocks and node counting
validation: 64 paired depth8 runs over32 human prefixes, plus32 sparse positions at fixed depth6; exact move/score/nodes/depth equality
speed_gate: Median and total paired human-prefix timing ratio >=1.10; serial alternating engine order; no candidate retuning
rules_gate: Rules, protocol, mates, draw properties, history boundary, sanitizer checks
strength_status: Timing equality does not prove a win-rate gain; no claim of field superiority without independent games
